job.value: spot a time-limited Autos deal worth grabbing

arrivedFrom.value: the Autos tab on Explore's top tab row

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The '11.11 Autos MEGA DEALS' hero and 'Best of 11.11 (11-15 Nov)' make it a deals page.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: On the first screen the teal 'Chat' on the 'Car wash' card leads, but further down every flash-deal and all-deals card repeats an identical teal 'Chat', so no single action stands out.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Chat' on a S$1.11 deal doesn't say whether it claims the deal or just messages the seller; 'Share' and 'Start' on 'Tell us your ideal ride' are clear.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Only 20 a day', '92% off', '12 left!' and '12-month contract' are plain to a car buyer.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Nothing is asked of the buyer beyond picking a deal.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each card shows two ticks and a price; detail is left to the deal page.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Hero, 'Best of 11.11' and 'Flash deals' all serve the campaign moment.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Cards carry price, discount and countdown; nothing to read before tapping.
